primary_goal: Project-guide hourly May electricity-energy, cost and carbon forecasts using only observations available at the end of April
target: 13-module complete-hour sum, provisional kWh under guide assumptions
source_policy: Read existing verified data; original and all earlier outputs are preserved
pretraining_design_correction: Initially proposed February28 was replaced by February25 before successful scoring, so all validation labels and model selection information precede the March29 internal test origin.

selection.objective: Mean of three validation-origin MAEs on offsets240..744 (505 hourly values per origin)
selection.secondary: Full745 path MAE, RMSE, R2; coarse-period metrics reported separately where available
selection.overlap_limit: Validation targets overlap between forecast origins. 1515 scoring rows are not1515 independent observed hours; unique target count and origin-level errors must be reported.
selection.feature_allocation_scaler: Each forecast origin fits from its own historical prefix only

coarse_models.target: Period hourly-average energy rate plus known future period duration, avoiding artificial month-length trends
coarse_models.daily_mapping: Forecast32 daily rates; multiply by24 for full-day energy and use historical-only hourly shares to form745 hourly outputs
coarse_models.weekly_monthly_mapping: Forecast each future calendar bucket rate and apply historical-only within-period profiles; never use future realized period totals
coarse_models.partial_periods: Preserve counts and coverage; full-period training targets must be complete and available before origin. Known partial-prefix statistics are explicitly labeled if used as features.
coarse_models.monthly_limit: Only4 complete months in full data and2 during the three validation fits. Use transparent level baselines rather than pretend to train a supported seasonal monthly model.

evaluation: All candidate model selection is based on validation hourly505 MAE, regardless of training resolution
unit_limits: Guide activePower/energy scaling and meter hierarchy remain unresolved; no unsupported rescaling or meter removal
post_EDA_limit: April/May were examined in previous work. This is a revised historical evaluation, not a pristine prospective blind test.
